'''MandalMotors''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] company located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Founded by the Mandalorian [[General/Legends|general]] [[Gustav Zenlav]], MandalMotors grew to be a large corporation, headed by a board of executives under the authority of a single [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]]. The company was headquartered in Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], where its hundred-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall [[MandalMotors tower|tower]] adorned with their unmistakable business logo became a well-known landmark around the city. MandalMotors was primarily a manufacturer of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], although the Mandalorian corporation was also notable for the creation of several [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] models, [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], and at least [[Canderous-class assault tank|one class]] of ground-based [[Tank/Legends|tank]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], MandalMotors developed a reputation for its outstanding ship designs and powerful military vessels.

A largely neutral company, MandalMotors was a driving force behind the economy of Mandalore, and sold its many products to any interested party willing to pay the necessary [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|units]] took to the company's [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ships]], while the radical Mandalorian [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] group were known to make use of [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transports]]. When [[Spar|Mandalore the Resurrector]] came to power late in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] and [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|his army]] seized MandalMotors' facilities solely for use by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with whom he had aligned the Mandalorians against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in their [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning war. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was [[Declaration of a New Order|born]] from the Republic, MandalMotors came under the sway of an [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] forcefully placed on the company's board, and produced [[Lictor-class dungeon ship|dungeon ships]] for the galactic regime. After the Empire [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fell]], MandalMotors became an ally of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], supplying several member worlds with military craft. When a lode of the precious and incredibly resistant [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] known as [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] was found on Mandalore in the aftermath of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], MandalMotors' work with the rare metal became the catalyst that elevated the Mandalorian world into a state of economic resurgence.

==History==
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Gustav Zenlav]] founded MandalMotors several [[Standard century/Legends|hundred years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The company created numerous [[Starship/Legends|starships]] including the [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]], one of which would come into the ownership of the famed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and eventually be known as ''[[Slave II]]''. They also manufactured the [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|StarViper-class attack platform]], one of which would become [[Xizor/Legends|Prince Xizor's]] [[Virago|''Virago.'']]
[[File:Virago.jpg|thumb|220x220px|Prince Xizor's ''Virago'']]

[[File:M22-T_Krayt_Gunship.jpg|left|thumb|A MandalMotors [[M22-T Krayt gunship]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Spar|Mandalore the Resurrector]] and his new army of [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] took control of the MandalMotors facilities for use by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with which Mandalore was then aligned.

Under the auspices of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], MandalMotors was not allowed to do business until an Imperial "advisor" was placed on the company's board of directors, although this did not stop the sale of weapons to [[Tyber Zann]]'s [[Zann Consortium/Legends|criminal organization]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], this "advisor" was ousted in favor of support for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

During the [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Mandalore]], in the midst of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], MandalMotors' hundred-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] [[MandalMotors tower|tower]] sustained heavy damage, but remained standing in spite of it. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the company was headed by [[Jir Yomaget]] and had donated [[MandalMotors Hall]]—a communal building where clan [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]] could gather to discuss Mandalorian [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and matters of importance, occasionally with the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]—to the community of Keldabe.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> After the discovery of a new vein of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] ore outside the settlement of [[Enceri]], production began on two new ''beskar''-reinforced designs, the [[Bes'uliik|''Bes'uliik''-class assault starfighter]] and the [[Tra'kad-class transport|''Tra'kad''-class assault vessel]]''.
